title: Implement generatePodioFieldConfig Tool
description: Create MCP tool that orchestrates authentication, fetching, and code generation. Must accept appId, appToken, and optional outputPath, perform full workflow: auth → fetch → generate, return path to generated file, field count, and constant name, never output sensitive tokens, handle all error cases gracefully, and create file at specified or default location.
details: Sprint 3 - App Fetching + TS Config Generation. Main MCP tool for generating field configs.
testStrategy: Test full workflow with valid inputs, invalid inputs, verify no token output, check file creation, verify return values.
